connector.name: Nummeropslag
connector.registryDescription: Privacy-first Danish caller ID, CVR company lookup, operator data, and community spam signals.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the desktop bundle nummeropslag-mcp-1.0.1.mcpb. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the andrey-tut account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
